# ShaadiShopping

> ShaadiShopping is India's expert wedding planning and vendor marketplace platform, currently focused on Patna and the wider Bihar region. It connects couples with verified wedding vendors and provides end-to-end coordination from venue booking through to the vidaai (farewell) ceremony — venues, catering, décor, photography & videography, bridal/groom fashion, makeup artists, mehndi artists, DJs, bands, and more.

ShaadiShopping is not a listings-only directory — every enquiry is followed up by a dedicated human wedding consultant who helps shortlist vendors, negotiate packages, and coordinate the event within the couple's budget and guest count.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.shaadishopping.com/): What ShaadiShopping does, featured vendors, and how the platform works end-to-end.
- [Plan Your Wedding](https://www.shaadishopping.com/plan): Guided wizard where couples submit city, budget, guest count, and service needs to get matched with vendors and an expert consultant.
- [Venues in Patna](https://www.shaadishopping.com/venues/patna): Curated directory of top banquet halls and wedding venues in Patna, with real photos and pricing. Locality guides for Danapur, Saguna Mor, Boring Road, Bailey Road, and Kankarbagh.
- [Patna hub](https://www.shaadishopping.com/cities/patna): City landing page linking to every vendor category available in Patna (venues, catering, décor, photography, makeup, mehndi, DJ/band, planning).
- [Blog](https://www.shaadishopping.com/blog): Wedding planning guides — e.g. court marriage registration in Bihar, best banquet halls in Patna, venue spotlights.
- [About](https://www.shaadishopping.com/about): ShaadiShopping's mission, team, and why couples choose the platform over generic listing sites.

## Frequently asked questions

- **How much does a wedding cost in Patna?** Venue rental starts from ₹80,000 (budget halls) up to ₹4 lakh+ (premium hotels); catering runs ₹450–₹1,200 per plate; bridal makeup ₹15,000–₹60,000; mehndi ₹8,000–₹25,000; decoration ₹60,000–₹3 lakh+; photography ₹35,000–₹2 lakh; DJ ₹15,000–₹60,000; wedding planners from ₹50,000. Exact pricing depends on guest count, season, and vendor tier — ShaadiShopping's consultants tailor a plan to the couple's stated budget.
- **How does ShaadiShopping work?** A couple submits their city, budget, guest count, and required services through the [Plan Your Wedding](https://www.shaadishopping.com/plan) wizard or a direct vendor enquiry. A dedicated human wedding consultant follows up, shortlists verified vendors that fit the budget, and coordinates quotes and bookings — it is not a self-serve listings site.
- **Which cities does ShaadiShopping cover?** Patna is the primary and most deeply covered market (35+ verified venues plus catering, décor, photography, makeup, mehndi, DJ, band, and planning vendors), with expansion across other Bihar cities served from the same vendor network.
- **Is ShaadiShopping free for couples?** Yes — browsing vendors, submitting enquiries, and getting consultant support is free for couples. ShaadiShopping is compensated by vendors, not couples.
- **How far in advance should couples book wedding vendors in Patna?** Venues and photographers are typically booked 3–9 months ahead (6–12 months during the November–February peak season); makeup artists and decorators 4–6 months ahead; DJs, bands, and mehndi artists 2–3 months ahead.
- **How do I contact ShaadiShopping?** WhatsApp or call the official line below — this is the single number for all vendor enquiries; individual vendors do not have separate public contact numbers on the platform.
